No, the pedestrian will likely not prevail. A misstatement of law is generally not actionable as misrepresentation unless the speaker stood in a fiduciary or other special relationship of trust with the claimant, and an adjuster dealing at arm's length with a third-party claimant does not. The pedestrian also cannot show justifiable reliance, because he rejected the $1,000 offer and hired counsel.

CONFIDENCE: 70
